alpha_role: fixed inside the trainable parameterization: physical offsets and maximum dynamic-gate strength are both multiplied by 0.5; no post-fit interpolation and no search
stations: topology-unique gauges complete in training, stopping and evaluation periods
training: 2010-2015 discharge plus training-period PML AET and GRACE state guardrails
evaluation: 2017-2018 development-only integrity check; inaccessible to fitting, stopping, normalization, alpha and seed selection; not the formal time-extrapolation result
seed_selection: lowest 2016 stopping objective among fixed seeds 260826, 260827, 260828
event_window: strict trailing 7-day window; all seven days must be finite and inside the same train/stop partition
event_shape: the current and preceding day must both be finite and inside the same partition
candidate_initialization: zero-state 2006-2009 burn-in during optimization; candidate-specific DYN2P periodic spin-up for final evaluation; the registered post-2010 washout sensitivity must pass
parent: refit from the fixed physical prior in this stage; old parent caches are forbidden
formal_time_extrapolation: 2019-2022 observations, unlocked only after final 230-Reach prediction hash
formal_space_extrapolation: 珠坑、昭平、瓦村（二）、盘江桥（三）, unlocked only after final 230-Reach prediction hash
